perks.name: Full Bore

Barrel optimized for distance.

  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling

Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Nadir Focus
perks.desc: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing add groups in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Void subclasses. The reprised Joxer's Longsword is a Heavy Burst pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "essentially just a worse high-impact auto". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Unstoppable, fires a 2-round burst and grants ×0.9 flinch when ADS as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are okay by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/2150012406/joxers-longsword hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/2150012406 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is right-ish and a little loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it just go for extra handling, and then with the magazine perk go for one of the combat effect mags or something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For dealing with add groups and synergising with Void builds, in the first trait perk column, Repulsor Brace provides a ×0.5 damage resisting Void overshield for 8s (10s when enhanced) after killing a void-debuffed enemy - duration boosted by ×1.5 with Echo of Persistence. In the second column you have the full set of void perks - Destabilizing Rounds spreads Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 4.5s (5.25s when enhanced), Demoralize spreads a ~4m AoE cloud of Void Weaken to nearby enemies for a ×1.15 boost to damage for your fireteam for 3s (5s when enhanced) on a crit kill or Withering Gaze applies the Void Weaken debuff to targets after ADS-ing for 1.4s (1.3s enhanced) for ×1.15 damage for a refreshable 6s for your fireteam, but if the stronger ×1.3 weaken has been applied from Tractor Cannon or Shadowshot, a proc will reapply at the higher value. There's a choice of origin traits - Roar of Battle grants +10 Stability and Handling for 6s after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s or Nadir Focus grants stacks for 2s for each shot fired to boost Range by up to +10 and Accuracy Cone Size to ×0.925 after ~4 bursts. If you're interested, Joxer's Longsword gets its name from Joxer, a veteran, but tragic Titan whose storyline is one of the most notoriously heroic - and foolhardy - tales in Destiny's lore. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 11 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/49VFDRj05iDXTJDOBqQpga?si=e61731a19fb64938) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor add groups in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content. Joxer's Longsword is only the second non-endgame Heavy Burst frame pulse rifle - it's a Crucible weapon so if you're focussing with Shaxx reset your reputation as many times as you can to get as many options as possible in the two trait perk columns. At base, the stats are on the low side by comparison with its end-game peers, but in-band when compared to Corrasion - 74 Range and 18 Zoom equate to 38.79m ADS and 21.55m hipfire, 33 Stability is ×1.1292 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 36 Handling is 0.43s ready, 0.39s ADS and 0.42s stow speed, 33 Reload Speed is a 2.18s reload and Recoil Direction is 59. Base magazine size is 30. Use the barrel perk to improve Handling, and then any of the combat effect magazine perks or something to help with the slow reload speed. In the first trait perk column, for end-game use, Shoot to Loot is always a good option, picking up power orbs and ammo bricks and reloading all your weapons. To match with that, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for 10s for just hitting three enemies, or for dealing with add crowds, Destabilizing Rounds spreads volatility and procs volatile rounds, or Demoralize spreads Weaken on a crit kill, effectively boosting damage to nearby enemies by ×1.18. Of the three origin traits, One Quiet Moment is probably the most useful for PvE, boosting Handling by +20 and Reload Speed by +40 with a ×0.95 animation duration after 5s of not dealing or receiving damage, or and 1.5s after you get a kill but if you're trying to hit crits, Nadir Focus boosts range by up to +10 and up to ×1.075 increased accuracy cone size as you fire. If you're interested, Joxer is a character from the "Xena: Warrior Princess" TV series. Recommended MW: Handling with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

At base, the stats are on the low side by comparison with its end-game peers, but in-band when compared to Corrasion - 74 Range and 18 Zoom equate to 38.79m ADS and 21.55m hipfire, 33 Stability is ×1.1292 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 36 Handling is 0.43s ready, 0.39s ADS and 0.42s stow speed, 33 Reload Speed is a 2.18s reload and Recoil Direction is 59. Base magazine size is 30. Use the barrel perk to improve Handling, and then any of the combat effect magazine perks or something to help with the slow reload speed. It might look a little old-fashioned now, but it you're new to Destiny and haven't already got a pulse rifle with Demolitionist or Pugilist in the first trait perk column and Desperate Measures in the second, they're a natural pairing, boosting damage by up to ×1.3 for 7s by combining weapon and ability kills, while regaining either grenade or melee energy on weapon kills. Of the three origin traits, One Quiet Moment is probably the most useful for PvE, boosting Handling by +20 and Reload Speed by +40 with a ×0.95 animation duration after 5s of not dealing or receiving damage, or and 1.5s after you get a kill but if you're trying to hit crits, Nadir Focus boosts range by up to +10 and up to ×1.075 increased accuracy cone size as you fire. If you're interested, Joxer is a character from the "Xena: Warrior Princess" TV series. Recommended MW: Handling with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "You've got so many options for spreading Weaken or Volatile with Joxer’s Longsword. Destabilizing Rounds is my choice because it spreads easily and has a shorter cooldown. Easy choice for killing trash mobs. Withering Gaze is nice for juicier targets like champions. And the newest perk Demoralize is just so incredible. Spreading Weaken on precision kills is just so easy. It also has a dope name so we can't pass that up." Recommended MW: Handling.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Heavy burst pulses haven't been ultra meta outside of a few specific player's hands. Lone Wolf is an easy pick for boosting stats passively and doubling when alone. Headseeker provides some forgiveness if you miss and Gutshot Straight boosts just the body shot damage, pushing total damage even further." Recommended MW: Stability.
